g.text: degraded: Working with reduced redundancy or capacity
degraded: Working with reduced redundancy or capacity
The whole system. The session cache is one box.
Open the session cache. The picture reflows; you still see everything.
Open both nodes too. Still the whole system.
Zoom in on node A: a Redis process and its append-only file.
Redis dies. The step marks the node failed and the cluster and API degraded.
Zoom out. Everything is still open; the states are where they were put.
Close it all. The closed boxes carry the state.
